MA_ROLL_OFF_WARNING_READ_THIS_BEFORE_TRU.finding: A BULLISH 20/50 CROSS ON QQQ IS MECHANICALLY ARRIVING WITHIN ABOUT ONE SESSION AND IT WILL BE A WINDOW ARTIFACT, NOT NEW DEMAND. Computed per the CLAUDE.md MA roll-off rule (compute what LEAVES the window, not just today's value).
MA_ROLL_OFF_WARNING_READ_THIS_BEFORE_TRU.the_arithmetic: The 20-day window is dropping the crash closes one per night: 661.73 leaves tonight, then 683.55, 687.99, 700.07. With QQQ merely FLAT near 710 the 20-day rises about +2.4/day (661.73 -> ~710 is +48.27, /20). The 50-day is dropping 744.00, 729.86, 722.51, 740.62 and therefore FALLS about -0.7/day. MA_ROLL_OFF_WARNING_READ_THIS_BEFORE_TRU.what_it_means: Any 'QQQ golden cross' headline or signal on 2026-08-27 or 2026-08-28 carries ZERO information about demand -- it is the July crash leaving a 20-bar window. Do not treat it as a confirming technical, and do not let a later run rediscover it as bullish evidence.
MA_ROLL_OFF_WARNING_READ_THIS_BEFORE_TRU.the_scope_limit_stated_honestly: This does NOT invalidate the 20-day as an INTRADAY level. A daily SMA is static during the session -- it only updates at the close -- so 712.1600 is a legitimate fixed reference for a same-session TACTICAL trade today. The roll-off matters for any MULTI-DAY hold, where the level would move ~2.4/day against a target the trade needs, and for any run tempted to read tomorrow's cross as a signal.
